statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation management
The procedure code billed is 93271 (Cardiac Event Monitoring)
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-97
The denial reason is that the requested service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
